q1_issues.issue: The entire content clause "that the ECB had not exhausted its ammunition for rate cuts" is unrepresented — no exhaust eventuality, no strength-0 denial, no ammunition and no rate cuts appear anywhere in the parse.
(Name ecb "ECB") is an orphan: the symbol ecb occurs in no other atom, so the only trace of the ECB is a label attached to nothing.
"his remarks" is a possessed plural but is encoded as a single singular witness sk_remark_1 with no GroupOf group, collapsing several remarks into one.
The possessor "his" is attached with (Agent sk_remark_1 sk_person_1); Possessive / genitive NP routes a possessive pronoun to PartOf or Possession, not to a thematic role.

q2_gaps: finite that-clause complement of a NOUN ("his remarks ... that P", "the claim that P") — clausal complements are specified only for attitude, perception and embedded-question VERBS, and Complements of nouns and adjectives covers argument PPs only
the subject/possessor of an event-denoting noun ("his remarks", "the ECB's statement") — the genitive rule gives only Possession/PartOf, and there is no route for expressing who made the remark
notes: The matrix clause (comment undercut remarks, in an interview, on Tuesday) is parsed cleanly; the loss is concentrated in the dropped that-clause and the resulting dangling ECB name.
